references.text: The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eye is healthy, your whole body will be full of light.
If you give your bread to the hungry and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light shall break forth like the morning, and your darkness shall be as the noonday.
Your word is a lamp for my feet and a light on my path.
The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eye is healthy, your whole body will also be full of light. But if it is bad, your body will also be dark.
